newsitem.title: USA: American White Cross files reorganization.
newsitem.headline: American White Cross files reorganization.

text.p: American White Cross Inc said Monday it has filed a reorganization plan and disclosure statement with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court.
The company said it hopes to successfully emerge from Chapter 11 by August 31.
The company said the reorganization plan incorporates the principal terms of the May 6 agreement with its major creditors.

The company said the reorganization and proposed treatment of creditors and shareholders is subject to approval of the disclosure statement, the vote of creditors and shareholders on the plan, and bankruptcy court approval.
